en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 9.1.
Hetuduka, Kusalattika (The Dyad on Roots, the Triplet on the Wholesome)
Root Condition (Hetu-paccaya): Dependent on a rootless unwholesome state,
there arises a rootless unwholesome state by way of root condition— dependent on a rootless [state].
Dependent on one unwholesome or indeterminate aggregate, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, a state that is neither-root nor wholesome arises by way of root condition:

dependent on aggregates that are neither-roots, unwholesome, or indeterminate, there arise [aggregates] that are roots. Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, a state that is neither-root nor wholesome...
And non-root, unwholesome states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-root, unwholesome state, a non-root, unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-root, unwholesome state, a rootless, unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a rootless non-virtuous state, there arise states that are both rootless and non-virtuous, and states that are neither-rooted nor non-virtuous, by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both rootless and non-virtuous, and a state that is neither-rooted nor non-virtuous, there arises a state that is rootless and non-virtuous...

[An unrooted, non-wholesome state] arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor wholesome and a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, a state that is neither-root nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor wholesome and a state that is neither-root nor wholesome, states that are both neither-root and non-wholesome, as well as states that are neither-root and non-wholesome, arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With root condition: nine … pe … with non-disappearance:
nine. With not-root: two; with not-object: three; with not-predominance: nine … pe … with not-kamma: three … pe … with not-nutriment: … pe … with not-path: one … pe … with not-disappearance: three.
(The same detailed expansion applies everywhere in the co-nascent section … pe … and in the associated section.)
Root-object condition:
A state that is neither-root nor wholesome is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state that is neither-root nor wholesome.
A state that is neither-root nor wholesome is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state that is not-root and not wholesome. [A state that is] neither-root...
A non-root unwholesome state is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a non-root unwholesome state and for a non-root neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome state.
A non-root unwholesome state is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-root unwholesome state. (Abbreviated. Under root: three; under object:
nine …pe… under decisive support: nine; under prenascence and postnascence: three …pe… under kamma: [three].
Three ... pe ... three in relation to nutriment ... pe ... three in relation to jhāna ... pe ... five in relation to dissociation ... pe ... nine in relation to non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome, states that are neither-root nor unwholesome arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome, a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome, a state that is not-root but unwholesome arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a rootless unwholesome state, there arise states that are both rootless and unwholesome, and states that are neither rootless nor unwholesome, by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both rootless and unwholesome, and a state that is neither rootless nor unwholesome, there arises a state that is rootless and unwholesome.

[It] arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome and a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome, a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome and a state that is neither-root nor unwholesome, states that are both neither-root and unwholesome and neither-root and unwholesome arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are nine ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (In all cases, nine.

dependent on one neither-root aggregate that is neither-indeterminate, three aggregates [arise]; dependent on three aggregates, one aggregate [arises]. Dependent on a neither-root ...
Dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither-cause nor indeterminate by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-cause nor indeterminate and has no root, there arise states that are both neither-cause nor indeterminate and have no root by way of root-condition.
